title: Egosurg: Arbitrary view synthesis for egocentric replay of operating room workflows from ambient cameras
abstract: arXiv:2510.04802v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Observing surgical practice has historically relied on fixed vantage points or recollections, leaving the egocentric perspectives that shape clinical decisions undocumented. Ambient fixed cameras capture the operating room (OR) at room scale but cannot recover what any individual team member actually saw. We present EgoSurg, a framework that reconstructs dynamic OR scenes from sparse wall-mounted stereo video and renders arbitrary, role-specific egocentric views without instrumenting personnel or interfering with clinical workflow. EgoSurg initializes a per-timestamp 3D Gaussian Splatting representation from scale-aware stereo depth and refines it with an image-conditioned diffusion model that corrects auxiliary rendered views, mitigating artifacts caused by limited camera coverage, crowding, and occlusion. translated_title: EgoSurg：从环境摄像头实现手术室工作流程的自我中心视角任意视图合成
translated_abstract: 历史上，观察外科实践依赖于固定视角或回忆，这使得塑造临床决策的自我中心视角未被记录。环境固定摄像头以房间尺度捕捉手术室，但无法还原任何个体团队成员实际看到的内容。我们提出了EgoSurg框架，该框架从稀疏的壁挂式立体视频重建动态手术室场景，并渲染任意、角色特定的自我中心视图，无需对人员佩戴设备或干扰临床工作流程。EgoSurg从尺度感知的立体深度初始化每个时间戳的3D高斯泼溅表示，并通过图像条件扩散模型进行细化，该模型纠正辅助渲染视图，减轻由有限摄像头覆盖、拥挤和遮挡引起的伪影。我们在四个真实机器人肺科手术和两个模拟全流程会话中评估了该框架，涵盖两种场景。
tldr: EgoSurg利用稀疏环境摄像头和3D高斯泼溅结合扩散模型，无需侵入设备即可重建动态手术室并生成任意角色的自我中心视图，解决了遮挡和覆盖不足的挑战。
en_tdlr: EgoSurg reconstructs dynamic operating room scenes from sparse ambient stereo cameras using 3D Gaussian Splatting and diffusion-based refinement, enabling arbitrary role-specific egocentric view synthesis without instrumenting personnel or disrupting workflow.
